mostWorthwhile.text: The B-cell sequence was most worthwhile: binding bacterial protein, receiving helper signals and branching into plasma and memory cells connected specificity to two different outcomes.

leastWorthwhile.text: The attempt to use activated helper T cells at the node was confusing because they had no available operation until the B cell was prepared.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the B cell first had to bind bacterial protein and display a fragment before receiving help; inspecting it exposed that missing step.

arbitrary.text: The separate step of connecting memory cells to the whole body felt somewhat administrative: the memory cells had already appeared in the node, although the final result explained their significance.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: tracing the matching cells through an encounter was engaging, especially where the descriptions distinguished antibody tagging from eliminating every bacterium.
